gloss: to lean forward; to bend forward eagerly

definitions.gloss: to lean forward physically; to bend one's body forward
definitions.explanation: To physically lean one's upper body forward, typically out of interest, curiosity, or eagerness.

definitions.gloss: to take an active interest; to get involved eagerly
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe becoming intensely interested in or engaged with something.

examples.japanese: {窓|まど}から{身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}す。
{彼|かれ}は{興味深|きょうみぶか}い{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いて{身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: He leaned forward, intrigued by the interesting story.

examples.japanese: {観客|かんきゃく}が{身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}して{試合|しあい}を{見守|みまも}った。
examples.english: The spectators leaned forward, watching the match intently.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}のホームでは{身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}さないでください。
examples.english: Please do not lean forward over the platform edge.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいプロジェクトに{社長|しゃちょう}{自|みずか}ら{身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}してきた。
examples.english: The company president himself got personally involved in the new project.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちは{手品|てじな}を{見|み}て{身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}しながら「すごい！」と{叫|さけ}んだ。
examples.english: The children leaned forward excitedly watching the magic trick and shouted 'Amazing!'

notes:
Composed of {身|み} (body) + を + {乗|の}り{出|だ}す (to lean out, to put forward). The physical action of leaning forward naturally extends to the figurative meaning of showing eager interest or personal involvement.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {窓|まど}から{身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}す: to lean out of a window
- {身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}して{聞|き}く: to listen with great interest
- {身|み}を{乗|の}り{出|だ}して{見|み}る: to watch eagerly, leaning forward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前|まえ}のめりになる: to lean forward; to be overly eager — can imply reckless eagerness
- {食|く}いつく: to bite at; to show keen interest — more colloquial; implies jumping at an opportunity
- {興味|きょうみ}を{示|しめ}す: to show interest — neutral; lacks the physical/visceral quality
